scope: Root integration, source-photo inspection and delivery review. Agent reports contain engine/rule, UI and storage detail. This report is not a claim that every retained historical file was behaviorally executed.

reviewed_files.review_boundary: Application boot; selection publication and destination context; generation/cancellation; rejection refill; private renderers; modal lifetimes; session/wear/Favorites mutations; backups; storage events and manual visibility.
Same-ID card source bindings; native private book renderer cancellation; final export context; detached copies of source metadata.
Known-code validation, transport bounds, context conversion and previous-selection preservation. Valid classification policy unchanged.
Permission and transport coordination, supersession epochs, fresh automatic weather before submit and callback cancellation boundaries.
Outgoing allowlist, endpoint constraints, response parse/size limits, ephemeral session and late cancellation; no real service call.
Separate reviewed-panel context, rejection publication boundary, reviewed module loading and runtime delivery hashes; independent UI/state review tracked separately.
Exact source/version contract, lazy index integrity, retry/error reporting; no data writes.
Captured request/outfit identity and final rejection veto around exported assessment packets; independently tested by storage reviewer.
Current dependency order and direct resource integrity/cache pins; same bytes as app.html.
Alias must match index.html bytes and dependencies.
Reachable current utility; exact return navigation and resource delivery.
Candidate-only substitutions; deterministic bundle, current-resource integrity and lazy module manifests; frozen historical base reproduction.
Independent verification of each actual current direct, lazy and utility resource against file bytes.
Native, pixel baseline and real two-tab browser jobs; synthetic profiles, source preservation, failure evidence.

source_photo_review.active_ids: DS001–DS048, DS050, DS051; DS049 remains retired
source_photo_review.inspection: All ten same-ID source/PDF-to-context sheets and ten current thumbnail sheets were visually inspected. Registered full/native frames are separately tested in actual browsers.
authoritative_decisions: All five reconstructed-shirt batches have owner approval; stale candidate wording in older metadata is not a missing permission.
DS026 deliberately keeps the older larger-check suit insert and approved small pink/light-blue gingham outside suits.
DS040, DS041, DS042, DS043 are No Tie only.
DS027 approved No Tie source has a closed-looking top button: No Tie does not promise a physically open top button.
Shared approved source photographs under distinct shirt identities are not automatically identity bugs.
DS035 isolated thumbnail masking must be judged on full native frames before any visual defect claim.
limits: Source sheets establish identity/provenance and visible approved appearance; they do not prove a physical garment color under every light.
Native alpha composition and browser image controls are Round3 acceptance gates, not inferred from isolated thumbnails.

root_repairs.issue: View current could reveal a retained rejected manual outfit.
root_repairs.repair: Synchronize and recheck destination rejection context before reveal; unreadable/rejected state stays hidden.

root_repairs.issue: Private comparison, stylist and export renderers could wait forever after UI cancellation.
root_repairs.repair: Forward cancellation to actual pending image work and settle/free private canvases.

root_repairs.issue: Changing method or context could leave previous generation work eligible to publish.
root_repairs.repair: Advance generation and cancel work on invalidation; preserve the initiating pre-submit automatic-weather refresh.

root_repairs.issue: App mutations could overwrite another tab or finish after a modal closed.
root_repairs.repair: Use actual-store exclusive locks and revalidate captured modal/context/selection before writes; preserve synchronous rejection publication callbacks.

root_repairs.issue: Wardrobe exact-item choices were not retained as Home preferences and could leave stale recommendations.
root_repairs.repair: Persist the explicit choice and invalidate the previous recommendations.

root_repairs.issue: Older file reads could replace newer backup import previews or reopen a closed panel.
root_repairs.repair: Latest-read and modal token guards before preview/error publication.

root_repairs.issue: Unknown weather codes with measurable precipitation were accepted as light rain.
root_repairs.repair: Validate the weather code against the existing code set before classification.

root_repairs.issue: A late service response could sign back in after Disconnect.
root_repairs.repair: Discard aborted or superseded replies after body read; request privacy allowlist unchanged.

root_repairs.issue: Separately delivered current modules could be paired with cached older modules.
root_repairs.repair: Derive content URL and SRI from actual current files for both app entrypoints, reviewed lazy loads and suit-photo utility.

claims_boundary: Finite evidence supports the specified contracts. It does not prove universal bug freedom, pixel equality on every physical device, or execution of every historical snapshot.
